controlIdMeaning: control is the exact imported SVG layer name from the manifest. controlNodeId is included only when the native-link registry already records the actual Figma control node. sourceId and dstId are actual registered Figma frame IDs.

actions.navigate: Navigate to the registered destination and dismiss overlays.
actions.open: Open the registered destination overlay at its recorded position.
actions.swap: Swap the current overlay for the registered destination; preserve its base.
actions.close: Close the current overlay to its existing base; dst is null.

blockers.impact: Closing onto help-draft and reopening its event would show Draft again, losing the recorded waiting/declined state.
blockers.needed: Use native status variables or distinct waiting/declined calendar base frames with the matching event destination. Until then use outcome/reset/prepare-another-request actions; no deceptive Close link is queued.

ambiguities: Figma Log in is an explicitly simulated account transition; captured form has blank fields. It returns to skills-signed with the existing saved Analytical thinking choice.
Search input click advances to a prepared query and results. This is a sample prototype transition, not arbitrary text input.
Set a weekly routine and Schedule later are actual radio inputs with empty exported labels. Their exact IDs are selected by captured input order and adjacent text. No input ID was invented.
Routine destination has prepared Mon/Wed times. Days/time controls are not included because no intermediate selection-state captures are available.
Plan Review can select a conflicting learning event rather than the care event. The queue uses the exact school-pickup event control instead.
Declined assistance keeps the conflict. Only accepted assistance closes to plan-resolved.
Account/setup-dependent global navigation and external links are outside this essential queue.
